relationships.subject: IL-6
relationships.evidence_quote: Dominguez et al. showed that the intrathecal administration of an anti-rat IL-6 antibody to SNI male rats decreased p-STAT3 levels.

relationships.subject: GM-CSF
relationships.evidence_quote: granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF) was used to activate the JAK2 and STAT3 signaling pathways in DRG neurons, ultimately facilitating Nav1.7-1.9 transcription

relationships.subject: α7nAChR
relationships.evidence_quote: where it modulates chronic pain by inhibiting phosphorylation of its downstream molecules JAK2/STAT3 and release of the proinflammatory cytokines IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α

relationships.subject: AG490
relationships.evidence_quote: Liu et al. discovered that intrathecal injection of AG490 significantly restrained the synthesis of pro-IL-1β and maturation of IL-1β, thus attenuating SNI-induced mechanical and cold allodynia in male mice

relationships.subject: JAK2/STAT3 pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: The suppressor of cytokine signaling 3 (SOCS3) is a target gene of the STAT3 transcription factor

key_findings: Review: aberrant JAK2/STAT3 activation in DRG, spinal dorsal horn and red nucleus drives chronic pain via microglia/astrocyte activation and proinflammatory cytokines.
JAK2/STAT3 inhibitors (e.g. AG490) attenuate allodynia in multiple chronic pain models.
